Adam is an [[NPCs|NPC]] vendor of the [[Village|The Village]]. He is found south west of [[The Dead Horse]], selling pottery products. There are two {{Item|clay}} pits next to his house, neither of which can be utilized by the player.

===Purchasing===
This vendor does not purchase any craftables. Strangely, Adam also does not purchase the commercial blessing. This is typical for vendors who have all tiers already unlocked, like [[Clotho|Clotho,]] but Adam requires you to unlock the other tiers first.

==Stranger Sins==
===Quests===
====Clay Shards====
Adam holds the {{Item|Clay Shards}} artifact. To get it from him he asks you to do 2 things for him.

First he'll ask you to upgrade your [[Tavern]] to 40 quality, which requires 30 {{Item|Wooden plank}}, 30 {{Item|A piece of stone}} and 12 {{Item|Simple iron parts}} for an upgrade. You'll need to add 2 tables (8 {{Item|Wooden plank}} and 8 {{Item|Nails}} each) to the new spots that become available as well as have all previous artifacts on display to reach 40 tavern quality.

Secondly he'll ask you to help him with voices that bully him at night that leave no footprints. To deal with this return to his house after midnight and find [[Yorick]] outside. After a chat [[Yorick]] agrees to leave Adam alone. Return in the morning and talk to Adam to receive the {{Item|Clay Shards}} and +20 reputation with Adam.

====Ancient Keys====
Adam has the {{Item|Ancient Keys}} in his house. Before you can enter his house you need to show him your interest in art and bring him 3 {{Item|Porcelain pitcher}}. He won't be impressed and will offer you 5 silver or you can choose to keep your {{Item|Porcelain pitcher}}. Next you can talk to the [[Merchant]] to obtain 3 rare vases but he's sold them already to the [[Beekeeper]]. The [[Beekeeper]] seems to believe Adam is his arch nemesis and you conspire to fill the vases with poison which was stolen from the [[Beekeeper]] by [[Dig]]. Talk to [[Dig]] and answer anything to his riddle to get the right "Poison Cake" answer. Take the {{Item|Cake with bee poison}} to the [[Beekeeper]] to receive the {{Item|Vases of poison}} to bring to Adam. This will gain you another +20 reputation with him allowing you to enter his home and grab the {{Item|Ancient Keys}} from his chest by his bed. The chest also contains 3 [[Porcelain pitcher]], 5 [[Ceramic jug]], 3 [[Red jelly]], [[Beet slices]], 2 [[Bottle of berry juice]], 20 [[Ceramic bowls]] and a [[Rusty hammer]].
